title: Keep highlight thickness stable while zooming
description:
After zooming the PDF Viewer in and out quickly, highlight lines and structure markers could look massively thick — wide enough to cover the sheet notes. Stroke width was staying fixed in page pixels while the sheet shrank, and Viewer→Map sync sometimes multiplied thickness by the zoomed page size ratio.

PipeSync now paints strokes and structure markers scaled to the current Viewer zoom (page size vs base size), and no longer inflates stroke width when projecting highlights onto the Map.

Who is affected: PipeSync PDF Viewer (continuous) on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh, then Ctrl+wheel zoom in/out rapidly — lines and MH markers should stay proportional to the plan.
changeLog: Scale Viewer highlight stroke width with page zoom so zoom-out cannot fatten lines.
Scale structure node markers/labels with the same Viewer zoom factor.
Stop multiplying stroke by zoomed page size when projecting Viewer→Map highlights.
Store overlayZoom as intrinsic page zoom (page.w / viewerBaseW), not CSS viewport zoom.
